name: Capacities
tagline: Capacities is a personal knowledge management tool built around object types — notes, books, people, projects — rather than pages and folders, creating a richer, more structured knowledge graph. Its AI assistant writes, summarises, and generates connections between your objects. Researchers, writers, and students use Capacities to build a living knowledge base that goes beyond flat note-taking.
